audience: print-on-demand sellers who make posters, mugs and other products with Gelato

useCases.title: Browse the catalog and find a product
useCases.text: The AI lists catalogs, reads the attributes of one catalog, and searches its products by attribute values to find the product you need.

useCases.title: Price a product and quote shipping
useCases.text: The AI reads production prices per quantity, and quotes an order for a recipient address with shipment methods and delivery days. Nothing is created or charged.

useCases.title: Check stock by region
useCases.text: The AI checks if stockable products are in stock in a region such as EU or UK, with the replenishment date when known.

useCases.title: Track recent orders and shipments
useCases.text: The AI searches orders by status, country, store or date, and opens one with items, tracking codes and totals.

useCases.title: Create, submit or delete drafts, or cancel orders
useCases.text: The AI creates a draft order. After your confirmation it submits the draft, which starts production and charges the account, or deletes the draft, or cancels an order before production.

useCases.title: Create a store product from a template
useCases.text: The AI reads a template and its image placeholders, then creates a product in a connected store from your images. It can check the products of the store.
